_title: dossiq: case, powers from the mandate matrix
_note: What you see: the Powers panel on the case: the mandates your role holds for this case type, with Mandate, Description, Ceiling, Sub-delegation, Valid now and Validity period, and the filter What can I do myself? that shows only what you may decide without a second signature.
